high_priority.improvement: Collect more OOS training examples to reduce false accepts
high_priority.rationale: OOS false accepts are the dominant error across all models; more OOS training data directly addresses the distribution mismatch.

high_priority.improvement: Merge or relabel persistently confused intent pairs within the same domain
high_priority.rationale: Several intent pairs share near-identical semantics and consistently confuse all models.

high_priority.improvement: Apply confidence thresholding in deployment to flag uncertain predictions
high_priority.rationale: Many errors occur at high confidence; a deployment threshold could redirect uncertain queries to human review.

high_priority.improvement: Evaluate temperature scaling for post-hoc calibration improvement
high_priority.rationale: Calibration varies significantly across models; temperature scaling could improve reliability without retraining.

medium_priority.improvement: Add pretrained word embeddings (GloVe, word2vec) to Text CNN and BiLSTM
medium_priority.rationale: Pretrained embeddings could improve generalization especially for rare words and OOS queries.

medium_priority.improvement: Systematic hyperparameter tuning (dropout, hidden size, learning rate)
medium_priority.rationale: Current configs use limited grid search; broader exploration may improve all models.

medium_priority.improvement: Add parameter-count vs accuracy Pareto analysis
medium_priority.rationale: Quantify the efficiency-accuracy trade-off to guide model selection for deployment.

medium_priority.improvement: Add threshold analysis for OOS detection with operating-point selection
medium_priority.rationale: Enable tunable precision-recall trade-off for OOS detection in production.

lower_priority.rationale: Establish an upper-bound reference for the lightweight models evaluated.
Validate whether findings generalize beyond CLINC150.

lower_priority.improvement: Subword tokenization (BPE, WordPiece) for better OOV handling
lower_priority.rationale: Reduce OOV rates and improve generalization to unseen vocabulary.

lower_priority.improvement: Multi-task learning combining intent classification and OOS detection
lower_priority.rationale: Joint training may improve OOS discrimination by explicitly modeling the boundary.

lower_priority.improvement: Bootstrap confidence intervals for more rigorous statistical comparison
lower_priority.rationale: 3 repeated runs provide limited statistical power; bootstrapping would strengthen claims.
